trades.name: LAAF of Friday's high
trades.quote: Short a LAAF of Friday’s high targeting 29402, 369, 339. and 300 (honorable mention levels in this scenario I suppose) on the way to the weekly 29203-29241 level. I’ll rate this an A-/B+ and the only reason it isn’t higher is because of the demand left behind on Friday in or around the above reference honorable mention levels (which also have profile reasons to warrant honorable mention status).

trades.name: LBAF of Thursday's low (weekly 29203-29241)
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of Thursday’s low (really the weekly 203-241) is also an A-/B+. Normally a long would be rated lower than a short given recent context but the buy response in the low 200s has been excellent and the bullish RTH gap is simply too important to ignore. In this case I would say 285-300 is an honorable mention to reclaim for trade management purposes.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low

trades.name: Fail or LAAF of 7709-7713
trades.quote: Short a fail or LAAF of 7709-7713 simply has to be an A/A- because if sellers are serious to start the week, then they will strongly defend this and take ES through this past week’s low relatively quickly.
